name: com.igame.platform.others.GameOperationActivity
description: The EGLS (EasyGames) Android Game Platform SDK opens this screen for optional app-rating, Facebook promotion or sharing, and LINE promotion activities requested by the game. It presents configured images or links and returns whether the player completed or cancelled the activity.
disableEffect: The SDK's rating and social-promotion screens stop working, while the game's other screens remain available.
